content: Yaaqoobey Laaba Soon
Hessafe guye Yaaqoobey dendi biidi arshey mokkiza baggara diza asata dere gakkides.

Histtidi issi demban haaththa ollay dizayssa be7ides; heedzdzu cuga dorsi qasse he haaththa olla achchan ichchides; ays giikko wudey wuri haath uyizay he ollazappe; he haaththa ollaa doona tuchcha shuchchayka gita.
Dorsa wudey wuri heen shiiqida wode wudeza heemmizayti haaththa olla doonappe he shuchchaa genderisidi dorsaa ushsheettes. Ushshidi he shuchchaa haaththa ollaan zaaridi tucceettes.
Yaaqoobey isttas, «Haytoo! Intte awappe yidetii?» gi oychchides. Isttika, «Nuni Kaaraaneppe yidos» gi yootiin,
izi, «Naakoores naaza naa Laaba ereetii?» gides. Isttika, «Ee, iza nu eroos» gida.
Yaaqoobey isttas, «Izi lo7o dizee?» gi oychchiin, «Ee, lo7okko; iza naa Eraheelo dors ekka yizaaro hanno beya» gida.
Histtiin Yaaqoobey isttas, «Be7ite! Arshey ha7i dhoqqan dees; mehe soo shiishshiza wodey buro gakkibeenna; dorsata haath ushshidi efi heemmiishshite» gides.
Gido attiin isttas, «Mehey wuri shiiqana gakkanaas, shuchchaa haaththa ollaza doonappe genderisana gakkanaas nuni ushshanaas dandayokko; hessafe guye nuni mehaa ushshana» gida.
Izi buro haasayan dishin dorsata heemmizay izo gidida gishshas Laaba naya Eraheela ba aawaa dorsata laagga ekkada gakka wodhadus.
Yaaqoobey ba aayey isha Laaba naa Eraheeli dorsata be7ida wode biidi ollaa doonappe shuchchaa genderisidi ba aayey ishaa dorsata haath ushshides.
Yaaqoobey Eraheelo yeeridi ufayssafe dendidayssan ba qaala dhoqqisidi yeekkides.
Yaaqoobey izis aawa dabbonne Irbiqa naa gididayssa Eraheelis yootiin iza woxxa baada ba aawaas yootadus.
Laabay ba michchey naa Yaaqoobe wore siyida mala izara gaagganaas woxxides; woxxi gakkidi iza idimmi yeeri ekkidi ba soo efides; heen Yaaqoobey ba hanidayssa ubbaa Laabas yootides.
Laabay iza, «Neni tumu ta ashonne ta suuththa» gides. Yaaqoobey izara issi agina kumeth uttides.
Yaaqoobe Uneteth
Hessafe guye Laabay iza, «Neni taas dabbo gidida gishshas taas coo mela ooththanee? Ane nees ay qanxxanaas bessizaakko taas yoota» gides.
Laabas nam7u macca nayti deettes; bayray sunththi Liya, kaaloya Eraheelo.
Liya ayfey shola; Eraheeli ayfey gidikko lo7o.
Yaaqoobey Eraheelo siiqida gishshas, «Tani nees kaalo nayo Eraheeli gishshas nees laappun layth ooththana» gides.
Laabay, «Izo hara asas immanaappe nees immizayssi lo7o; neni tanara hayssan deya» gides.
Hessa gishshas Yaaqoobey Eraheelo ekkanaas laappun layth ooththides; gido attiin izi izo siiqiza gishshas izas wodezi keehi qaanth misatides.
Hessafe guye Yaaqoobey Laaba, «Ta machcho taas imma; ta wodey wurides; tani izo ekkana koyays» gides.
Hessa gishshas Laabay heen diza ubba asaa xeygi shiishshidi, bullachcha kessides.
Gido attiin gadey qammiin izi ba naa Liya efidi Yaaqoobes immides; Yaaqoobeykka izo ekkides.
Qasse Laabay ba aylleyo Zilfo ba naa Liyas aylle gidana mala immides.
Gadey wontiin xeelliza wode hekko Liya gidadus! Histtiin Yaaqoobey Laaba, «Hayssi neni ta bolla ooththidayssi aazee? Tani nees ooththiday Eraheeli gishshas deennee? Tana ays cimmadii?» gides.
Laabay iza, «Nu biittan bayraya dishin kaaloyo azinaas immizayssi woga deenna.
He mishirateththa saamintta ubbaa wursa; qasse kaalotizaarokka nuni nees immana; hessafe guye hara laappun layth taas ooththaasa» gides.
Yaaqoobey hessaththo hanidi he saaminttaa wursides; hessafe guye Laabay ba nayo Eraheelo izas immides.
Qasse Laabay ba aylleyo Biliha ba naa Eraheelis aylle gidana mala immides.
Yaaqoobey Eraheelokka ekkides; Eraheelo Liyappe aaththi siiqides; hara laappun layth Laabas ooththides.
Yaaqoobe Nayta Yeleteth
Yaaqoobey Liya Eraheeli mala siiqonttayssa be7idi GODAY izis yeliza uloza doydes; gido attiin Eraheelis nay baa.
Liyay shaarada attuma naa yeladus; iza sunththaaka Oroobeele ga sunththadus; ays giikko iza, «GODAY ta meto be7ides; ha7i tumu tana ta azinay siiqana» gadus.
Iza qasseka shaarada ha7ikka attuma naa yeladus; iza, «GODAY tani dosettonttayssa be7ida gishshas taas hayssaka gujjides» gaada iza Simoona ga sunththadus.
Iza qasseka shaarada attuma naa yeladus; iza, «Tani izas heedzdzu attuma nayta yelida gishshas ta azinay ba wozina taakko zaarana» gaada iza Lewe ga sunththadus.
Iza qasseka qanththatada attuma naa yelada iza, «Hi7a tani GODAA galatana» gadus; hessa gishshas iza Yuhuda ga sunththadus; hessafe guye yelo essadus.

footnotes.text: Oroobeele guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Hashshu Attuma naa!» woykko «Ta meto be7ides» guussa.
Lewe guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Ba wozina taakko zaarana woykko siiqon oykettana» guussa.
